name: rfq-insight
description: Analyse an RFQ package folder and generate the AVL RFQ Insight PowerPoint deck with evidence-checked findings.
short_description: Analyse RFQs and build evidence-backed decks
long_description: Point RFQ Insight at the folder holding an RFQ package (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text, CSV, images and Outlook e-mails with their attachments) or attach the documents in chat, and it answers the twelve fixed RFQ Insight sections, rates each section's confidence High, Medium or Low, verifies its own claims in an isolated pass and writes the AVL-branded PowerPoint deck to the folder's output directory.
